rationale: Real Qwen2 CUDA/int8 gate and nine complete Qwen2.5 diagnostic runs passed. Head dominates gradient norm; analytic mean-CE head gradient, paired batches/initial heads, optimizer coverage/state, frozen base and exact adapter/magnitude/head reload verified. Preserve all training hyperparameters, spike threshold and clipping. No accuracy superiority inference from the diagnostic.

formal_plan.basis: Observed GPU lifetime + 9 * sum(50-step train_wall_seconds), retaining observed setup/final-test/export/startup overhead; includes repeated validation. Estimate, not guarantee.

limitations: Simplex importance max deviation from one remains about 1.1e-5 and floor rounding yields ranks 7–8 under joint clipping.
DoRA adds 21504 magnitude parameters; equal initial rank is not equal parameter count.
Nine formal runs must execute independently on one new GPU with this exact image/source; old six-run results are historical only.
